card.name: Small words in device and seal instructions
card.fires_on: Small linking words (if, is, the, to) and unit numbers in instructions about checking a package seal, indicator, syringe or dose window. They sit just before a visible state or mark, such as a broken seal, a black indicator or a dose line.

modes.label: Seal and indicator checks
modes.description: The word "if" or "is" just before a condition of the seal or indicator.
modes.example: Do not use<< if>> seal is broken or missing.

modes.label: Dose window and syringe steps
modes.description: Linking words in steps about the dose selector, dose window or syringe markings, just before the thing to look for.
modes.example: Turn the dose selector knob until the drop symbol<< is>> centered in the dose window.

card.writes: It seems to prepare words that describe a visible appearance, such as colors (blue, yellow, red, colored).
card.plain: It fires on little words in device instructions right before the label describes what you should see, such as a seal state or a color.
